reviewer_does_not_see: the V1 verdict for this opportunity
the option-failure diagnosis and its cause labels
the V2 contrast set, matrix, blueprint or competitor classification
any author expectation about the outcome
protocol.standard: Section 14.2 of the design, precommitted before any V2 item existed: any count above zero on the eleven safety dimensions rejects the item.

G2-MED-03.comment: The three findings are a natural sequence for a community department stabilising a transfer, and nothing in the stem exists only to kill an option: the low pressure, the raised venous pressure and the clear lungs are one physiological pattern, not three separate insertions. Both reflex answers, beta blockade for demand and a diuretic for the venous pressure, are defeated by findings the stem states rather than by findings it withholds, which is what makes the item hard honestly. The vasopressor option is settled differently and correctly: the stem does not claim end-organ hypoperfusion is absent, and the rationale does not either. It says preload has not yet been optimized and names the point at which the option becomes right.
observations: CLM-ACS-RV-INFARCTION-STABILIZATION-01 names right-precordial ST elevation, especially V4R, as supporting the pattern. The stem does not give a right-sided tracing. The claim's grammar makes the clinical triad the identifying finding and V4R supportive, so the key rationale is within the claim, but an item at this level would be stronger with V4R stated.
A right-sided electrocardiogram is a reasonable parallel action a candidate might want. It is an investigation rather than a management step and does not displace the haemodynamic answer.

G2-OBGYN-01.REJECT_REASON: The keyed answer is not uniquely supported against a concept the item's own evidence defines. CLM-R2-OB-MASTITIS-ANCHOR describes inflammatory mastitis as an increasingly erythematous, oedematous and painful region of the breast with systemic signs and symptoms such as fever and chills, which is the stem word for word, and separates bacterial mastitis from it only as the progression that needs antibiotics to resolve. That is a response-to-treatment criterion; nothing available at presentation settles it. A candidate reasoning from the item's own cited packet could answer inflammatory mastitis and be right. Inflammatory mastitis is not among the options, so this is a best answer the option set cannot contain.
G2-OBGYN-01.comment: The three distractors are well handled and each is defeated on a stated finding or a cited discriminator: no fluctuance for the abscess, fever and erythema against the galactocele, and the absence of skin thickening and peau d'orange against the carcinoma. The stem is natural and the single explicit denial reads as an ordinary examination sentence. The defect is upstream of all of that. It is in the key concept's granularity: 'bacterial mastitis' sits one level finer than any feature in the frozen vocabulary can resolve.
observations: This is the same underlying problem the V1 item hit from the other side. There the key rationale had to render a cited claim as its categorical inverse to explain a firm non-fluctuant mass away; here the mass is not stated and the unresolvable neighbour is inflammatory mastitis instead of phlegmon. Both are the mastitis spectrum being finer than the option set.

G2-PHELO-01.comment: Every element of the results paragraph is something a trial report would carry, and each competing explanation is closed by one of them rather than by a sentence written to close it. Randomisation with comparable groups closes self-selection, an equal cumulative number diagnosed closes overdiagnosis, and an equal grade distribution closes length-time. The three distractors are the three explanations a candidate actually reaches for, and none is defeated by anything the stem leaves unsaid. The rationales name the specific stated result that settles each one.
observations: Tumour grade is a proxy for growth rate rather than growth rate itself, so the length-time exclusion rests on the standard operationalisation of that bias rather than on a direct measurement. This is how the bias is assessed in practice and the rationale does not claim more.

The option-realization contract flags OPTION_SPECIFICITY_MISMATCH because 'Overdiagnosis' is one word beside 'Healthy screenee (selection) bias'. The key is itself among the shortest options, so the length spread does not point at it and no cue is created.

G2-PHELO-02.comment: The stem states two things and both do work: the objective the board has set, and what the letter currently says about benefit. The three distractors are the three revisions a programme would actually consider, and each is defeated on content the stem gives. The detection-count rationale is the one to check, because it could easily have said the reader lacks the denominator when the stem is silent; it does not, it says the letter carries no denominator and no account of harm, which the stem states outright.
observations: Declared residual risk from the blind solve: the stem does not say whether the letter already tells people that attending is a choice, so a candidate could read the autonomy objective as calling first for a voluntariness statement. The stem describes one concrete deficiency and asks which revision best serves the objective, and the described deficiency is what the answer repairs, so the best answer is determinate. It would be more secure if the letter's existing voluntariness wording were stated.

G2-PHELO-03.comment: Safe and clean. The shortfall is the operative fact, the programme's planning strengths are stated so that the launch-with-evaluation option is genuinely attractive, and the pilot and threshold options are defeated by what the shortfall is rather than by silence about them. The threshold option is the one the stem does not directly address, and the rationale settles it on the discriminator rather than by claiming the threshold is correctly placed.
observations: Declared HARD, reads EASY. The shortfall is stated as absolute and unfixable, which is what makes the item safe and is also what leaves little to infer. This is the same tension the difficulty analysis of the V1 pilot recorded on this opportunity, and it is not repaired here.
